description: Use this when the user reports back on a TheDogs.app test drive plan (by plan ID or by describing how the trials went). Reviews a finished TheDogs.app test drive: takes the plan_id and, for each trial, whether it worked, was a struggle, or was skipped. Returns three blocks (Worked / Needs a solution / Not yet known), a fix for each struggle, an overall readout that weighs the decisive trial most, and better-matching, easier-to-find breeds when it didn't go well. Use when the user reports back on a test drive. Trial keys come from the plan (exercise, alone, coat, noise, space, kids, training, budget); map the user's words to them and leave out trials they didn't mention. Nothing is stored. In apps that display widgets, a visual card with these results is shown to the user; there, keep your text reply short and do not repeat every number or list from the card.

plan_id.description: The plan ID from create_test_drive_plan, e.g. td1.border-collie.7.0010110101

name: review_test_drive
title: Review the results of a dog-breed test drive
